# WO-112: Browser checks for wizard-step keyboard and reflow (CP-15)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-15 (accepted in CLAUDE-011)

## Goal
Per CP-15: real-browser (existing Playwright helpers) coverage of representative wizard steps at 320px and 640px (200% reflow), both themes: visible focus, logical tab order, labels linked to inputs, error messages tied to fields, no horizontal scroll, 44px targets. Fake values only; no secrets, no network, nothing sent. Reuse tests/test_wizard_a11y_browser.py patterns but don't edit that file.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests are offline and deterministic (fake values only), no new dependencies.
- Relevant builds/checks pass (.venv/bin/pytest -q tests -k wizard); existing tests stay green; ruff clean.
- Report product defects you find; don't fix files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_wizard_flow_a11y_browser.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Everything else, especially shared components, CSP/build config, dependencies, wizard source code, and release data.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
